High-precision reference reproduces the validated engine (value, L=80 km)
Printed Eq.(6)/Appendix A bracket for pXX
note: Eq.(6) as printed gives pXX = 0.5 at L=80 km, whereas CAL Eq.(30) / the engine give 0.0015695. The A^2 term must sit outside the factor 1/2: pXX = (A/2)[e^{-(1-O)g}+e^{-(1+O)g}] - A^2 e^{-2g}. With this form all derivatives agree with the reference (check T1-deriv-pXX); the same bracket slip appears in the printed pXX derivatives.

description: Truncation residual D_j
note: D_j (CAL Delta_j) is eta-independent in CAL and in the engine (residual_j), so D_j^(n)=0 for n>=1; Appendix E says D_j^(n) "follows identically" from the sqrt(pZZ) terms, which would only hold for a different D_j. The analytic derivatives with D_j constant match the reference to ~1e-10.
